parole.significato: chestnut colour; a reddish-brown colour resembling that of a chestnut
parole.testo: From kastanje (“chestnut”) + farge (“colour”). The first element is from German Kastanie (“chestnut”), ultimately from Ancient Greek κᾰ́στᾰνᾰ (kắstănă, “sweet chestnuts”); the second element is from Middle Low German varwe (“colour”), verwe (“colour”).

parole.significato: the spiny husk or shell surrounding a chestnut, especially the outer covering of a sweet chestnut or horse chestnut
parole.testo: From kastanje + skall, literally “chestnut shell”. The first element, kastanje, was borrowed from German Kastanie, ultimately from Ancient Greek Ancient Greek καστάνεια (kastáneia, “chestnut tree”); the second element, skall (“shell, peel”), is related to skjell and skål.
